limitations: Closes the operator-visible half of GH #430; no exit code changes, so a consumer with a failing strict verifier and a clean post-anchor surface still releases, now knowing what over.
The tainted count is a distance-to-first-failure measure because taint propagates unconditionally, and the disclosure says so.
non_goals: Changing what verify_post_anchor returns for any input; every exit code is byte-identical to today.
GH #430 suggestions 1 and 2, measured contract-breaking at the Phase 263 tribunal and refused with the measurement recorded.
exclusions: Attestation parity between the two modes, measured as not fixing GH #430.
Phase 263's declared-anchor design, VETOed at META_LEDGER entry #741.

phases: Phase 1: verify_post_anchor appends verified / disclosed / above-boundary counts to its summary lines, and governance_health._ledger_damage appends the strict verifier's FAIL and TAINTED counts to the OK note it currently emits as a fixed string, both additive so every existing substring assertion and every exit code is preserved
